It was right before it turned 2005.  I was hanging out with my cousin because I was on my Christmas break and we were talking and he asked me if I would like to try huffing ether.  He had just gotten back from the garage and had huffed a little bit.  He told me that his head had separated from his body and that it scared the shit out of him.  I told him I would think about it.  Later on that night we went out to the garage to 'clean his rc car'.  I was hesitent at first but I finally gave in.  I started to huff it but nothing was happining.  After about thirty second high went completly numb and I couldnt really talk.  I started to drool and laugh. and I was stumbling around.  I must have gotten a really high dose because I could hardly move.  We huffed about 4 more times in a half an hour.
